assign.outcome:
**API Doc landed — five Figma frames reassembled into one page, with zero new CSS.** Figma `109-369` is **five** frames, not the four the survey listed: `app-class-overview`, `app-class-api-reference`, `app-class-source-code`, and `app-class-tabbed` **twice** (`119:543` full-width, `121:434` capped to 1200 and centred). It is this framework's own docs site, so the live version of the design is [`ext/Doc`](/framework/ext/Doc/) — every rail row links into it.

![](apidoc-1440.png)

- [**API Doc**](/framework/styles/layouts/apidoc/) — the layout, on the wall · [full window](/framework/styles/layouts/apidoc/full/)
- The split IS the design: the `parts:` chips reproduce each frame exactly — `tabs` off + one body = frames 1-3, `header` off = frame 4, `+ measure` = frame 5. All six combinations rendered and measured: `frame1-app-class-overview.png` … `frame5-app-class-tabbed-capped.png`, `reassembled-all-on.png`.
- **Nothing needed a new rule.** Rail = `core/Sidebar`'s titled-group form · strip = `ext/tabs` · table = `ui.table()` (framework.css already makes a table scroll itself at 390px) · pill = `ui-badge ui-pill h4 accent` · trail = `ui-crumbs` · a dark code block is a bare `pre`.
- **Verified** at 400 / 1280 / 1440 / 1920 / 3440 on both urls: `documentElement.scrollWidth === clientWidth` everywhere, zero console errors. `apidoc-400.png`, `apidoc-1440.png`, `apidoc-3440.png`, `wall-1600.png`.
- **Three defects found by looking, all fixed:** a full-width breadcrumb over a centred column put the trail 1100px left of its heading at 3440 (one `axis()` helper now) · `sidebar/`'s `.basis` left the collapsed burger bar 19em wide at 400 (`flex: 1 0` against a 999 grow) · the terminal title bar took `--code-bg` without `--code-ink`, so its label was invisible. **Plus a trap that never throws:** `icon: "developer_guide"` is Material *Symbols*, the site loads Material *Icons* — it rendered as 291px of literal ligature text and split the wall card's title in two.
- **Left:** `styles/layouts/doc/decisions.md` has no entry (outside this task's fence, eight agents live) · `ui.table()` cannot stretch its inner table, so it sits at ~80% of the column where the comp spans it — `ui/table/` was not this task's file. Four questions and three dilemmas in [`figma/questions.md`](/framework/ai/2026-08-18/figma/).
